summary: Aris Mining filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a September 9, 2026 news release announcing its inclusion in the 2026 TSX30, the Toronto Stock Exchange's annual ranking of the 30 top-performing TSX-listed companies by dividend-adjusted share price performance over three years. Aris reported 563% dividend-adjusted appreciation for the three years ended June 30, 2026. No transaction, offer, or capital event is disclosed. The filing is a routine recognition announcement; no board recommendation, advisor, pricing, or structural terms appear. No deal terms are stated.
